recentItems.title: Ukraine launches its own FP-7 ballistic missile! Russia's chemical giant burns near Moscow
recentItems.description:
A fire at a chemical plant near Moscow, the first combat deployment of the Ukrainian FP-7 ballistic missile, and new ammunition for F-16s — the main topics of this issue. We cover a facility linked to the production of ammunition and explosives, strikes on Russian oil refineries, and the results of Operation "Vivaldi" in the Lyman direction. Also in focus — Ukraine's defense cooperation with the EU, British sanctions against the shadow fleet, and Putin's statements. Separately, we analyze the Russian satellite project "Rassvet": what threats it poses to Ukraine, its technical limitations, and why the Armed Forces of Ukraine need expanded access to Starlink and Patriot missiles.

recentItems.title: They fled the front so fast that they forgot the ‘RELIC’: The Russian army lost a ‘gift’ from Putin
recentItems.description:
"Relics of Dmitry Donskoy" lost at the front? Reports have emerged in Russian Telegram channels that part of the relic was left behind during the retreat near Lyman. A fragment of the prince's right arm had been sent to the front line with Putin's blessing to boost the occupiers' morale. We break down how this story has already turned into a scandal and why the Kremlin uses religious symbols in war. What lies behind promises of supernatural power, and how is Moscow turning "spiritual bonds" into an answer to drones and Starlink?

recentItems.title: Putin IS HIDING THE TRUTH! Classified refinery data and fuel panic in Russia
recentItems.description:
176 km² returned under Ukrainian control in the Lyman sector! Operation "Vivaldi" led to the liberation of settlements, the capture of dominant heights near Nove, and forced 250 Russian soldiers to surrender. How did Ukrainian commanders divert Russian reserves and strike in another sector? In this issue: the destruction of enemy drone depots, command posts, and logistics; the classification of data on Russian oil refineries; and fuel export bans. We also report on how Poland, Latvia, and NATO are strengthening their defenses amid Russian drones in Moldova and strikes near the Polish border. Watch for full details from the front lines and behind enemy lines.

recentItems.title: Kremlin in AGONY! Putin orders army to "drop the rules": drones attack bridges in Kyiv
recentItems.description:
The Kremlin has ordered to throw out the "rules of war": Zelenskyy reported intercepted communications obtained by Ukrainian intelligence. In Ukraine, the power grid is being prepared for winter: reinforcement of substation protection, simplifying shelter construction, and building equipment reserves are under discussion. Meanwhile, the U.S. will deploy Marines to the Baltic Sea to support the NATO mission. The UK reports Russian attempts to build a shadow fleet to bypass sanctions and fund the war. What do these statements mean for Ukraine and European security? Watch the key news and details of international events in our report.
